title: City, craft and coast
description: Five connected stories. Read in this order or begin wherever your curiosity takes you. Arrange travel and timings separately.

chapters.title: Bhubaneswar
chapters.invitation: Begin with the city. Let one carved doorway slow you down.

chapters.title: Dhauli
chapters.invitation: From a city of many timelines, turn to a hill where remembrance takes a different shape.

chapters.title: Konark
chapters.invitation: Keep looking at what stone can say. At Konark, a wheel is a beginning, not the whole story.

chapters.title: Puri
chapters.invitation: Let the story open towards the sea. Make room for the town, a meal and an unhurried stretch of shore.

chapters.title: Raghurajpur
chapters.invitation: From the town and shore, follow your curiosity towards the makers. Look closely, ask respectfully, and give a story time to unfold.

editorial_note: Original Project Odisha connective framing, based on the linked guides. Reading order is not a verified itinerary; no durations, distances or service promises are added.
